messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: version 1.0 almost ready!
parts:
The core ref manual is done (modulo proofreading
and anything I need to add if we do discrete
sampling). I think Matt's done with NUTS 2, but
it hasn't been merged into the trunk.

There's more details in Git under doc/notes/TO_DO.txt,
but here's the exec summary of the to-do for version 1.0:

* release tarball/doc (Daniel)
* final Stan/code home page cleanup (Bob, Daniel)
* check user vars don't end with "__" (Bob)

It'd be nice to have

* more BUGS models running (Jiqiang, Bob, Daniel, ...)
* discrete samplers (Matt)
* more API doc (Bob)
* speed tests relative to BUGS/JAGS (Daniel)
* flag user variable declarations ending with "__" (Bob)
* more programming techniques in manual (Bob)

In fact, it'd be nice to sit down and go over
the entire API and privatize everything we don't
think a user will need and doc everything we think
a user might call. Somehow the doc looks terrible
as is with everything jumbled into a few namespaces
(which is the C++ convention).

- Bob
